facts.P1_fx_receipts: Yes, freely; EU rules ban restrictions on payments.
facts.P2_fcy_account: Yes: many banks offer foreign-currency sub-accounts (Fremdwährungskonto).
facts.P3_local_gateways: Local gateways not researched yet; see the services listed above.
facts.L1_registration: Freelancers register with the Finanzamt via ELSTER within a month; traders also register a Gewerbe.
facts.L2_tax_id: Tax ID (Steuer-ID) from the Federal Central Tax Office.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: Worldwide income taxed, progressive up to 45% plus solidarity surcharge.
facts.L4_vat_gst: 19% VAT; no VAT under €25,000 last year with the Kleinunternehmer scheme.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: Online buyers can withdraw within 14 days.
facts.L7_incentives: Kleinunternehmer scheme: no VAT on invoices under €25,000 a year.

watch_out.text: Opting out of the Kleinunternehmer scheme binds you for five years.
Register with the Finanzamt within about a month of starting.
